jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian law firm with a strong presence in Antwerp, known for its pragmatic and business-oriented legal advice. The firm works with Belgian and international companies, investment funds, financial institutions and private clients. Its culture is built on accessibility, teamwork and intellectual curiosity, combining high-quality legal work with a human and down-to-earth approach.

Jobomschrijving

• Advising private equity firms, corporates and financial institutions on Banking & Finance matters
• Working on acquisition finance transactions, corporate lending and debt capital markets
• Assisting with insolvency-related aspects of finance transactions
• Conducting in-depth legal research and drafting legal documentation
• Working closely with senior associates and partners on complex files
• Building strong client relationships through clear and pragmatic advice 

• Belgian Master of Law degree with a strong academic background
• 1-6 years of experience as a lawyer, ideally with exposure to banking or finance law
• Analytical, detail-oriented and solution-driven mindset
• Able to work independently while thriving in a team setting
• Strong communication skills and a pragmatic, down-to-earth approach
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Motivated to grow in a challenging and professional environment

Our client is an interesting company within the maritime sector. They strongly focus on sustainability! To support one of their project teams, they are looking for an Administrative Project Assistant to support with document control.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is recruiting an Administrative Project Assistant to support with document control. This starts as a temporary mission of 6 months but with the potential of extension of the project/turning into a permanent opportunity. 

Your tasks:

• Check documents and verify that they meet the client's requirements
• Take the necessary action when problems are detected
• Manage the document flow every step of the process 
• Act as a point of contact within the project team 

• You are immediately available for this project
• You have experience within administration or you have obtained a relevant degree (business administration, business and languages, ...) 
• You are fluent in English, Dutch is a plus 
• You work very accurate and you are detail oriented 
• You are able to work with multiple programs and are good with them: Excel, SharePoint, Outlook, ... 
• You have your own transportation and can easily get to Kallo every day

jobs.occupation: Technical Support SAP - Manufacturing - East Flanders
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated SAP Technical Support Specialist (junior to medior level) to support daily SAP operations in an international manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for someone with initial experience in SAP support who is eager to grow their technical skills while contributing to stable and efficient business processes.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide second-line SAP support to end users
• Handle incidents and service requests within agreed timelines
• Monitor SAP systems and report potential issues
• Assist in routine maintenance tasks and system checks
• Support testing activities during system changes or updates
• Document solutions and contribute to internal knowledge bases
• Escalate complex issues to senior experts when needed
• Collaborate with IT and business teams across different locations
• Help identify opportunities for process improvements

• 2-6 years of experience in IT support or SAP support (or relevant internship/traineeship)
• Basic understanding of SAP systems (S/4HANA knowledge is a plus but not required)
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
• Strong willingness to learn and develop new skills
• Good problem-solving and communication skills
• Organized and able to manage multiple tasks

Our client is a fast-growing Belgian company operating in the food industry. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, we are currently looking for an Application Analyst / Project Manager to strengthen their IT Applications team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on professional who enjoys working closely with end users, optimizing business applications, and contributing to the continuous improvement of business processes. 

Jobomschrijving

 As an Application Analyst / Project Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and continuous improvement of the company's business applications.

Acting as the first point of contact for application-related issues, you will support users, coordinate improvements, and contribute to the evolution of the organization's application landscape:

• Manage and maintain business applications.
• Follow up on change requests, software updates, and application improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to reporting, data management, and process optimization projects.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners across multiple sites.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the IT applications environment.
• Provide first-line support to internal users for business applications.
• Analyze and resolve application-related incidents, escalating where necessary.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in application support, application management, functional analysis, or a similar role.
• Experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (FSCM) and/or Navision is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with or interest in Power BI, reporting solutions, and EDI/API integrations is a plus.
• Service-oriented mindset with a genuine willingness to help end users.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, hands-on, and capable of taking ownership.
• Team player with excellent communication skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Executive Assistant - International law firm (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Our client is an international law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide high-level administrative support to senior professionals, including complex calendar management, correspondence handling, preparation of presentations, and phone support.
• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including transportation, accommodation, meeting logistics, and expense management.
• Organize and coordinate meetings, conferences, networking events, and client-related activities.
• Manage and maintain electronic and paper records, ensuring accurate filing and document management.
• Handle extensive email management, prioritizing communications and responding to requests when appropriate.
• Support the billing process, including the preparation, review, and follow-up of invoices.
• Prepare and process a significant volume of complex billing activities, requiring accuracy, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills.
• Maintain databases, contact lists, and administrative records.
• Provide ad hoc administrative support and assist with various projects as required.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Senior Administrative Assistant role.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English (spoken and written). Trilingual proficiency is essential.
• Excellent command of the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Advanced knowledge of Excel is required, including the ability to work with complex spreadsheets, data management, reporting, and billing-related tasks.
• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with stakeholders at all levels.
• Able to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, flexible, and service-oriented team player.

Additional RequirementGiven the volume and complexity of the invoicing responsibilities, our client is specifically seeking someone with strong billing experience and the ability to manage complex invoicing processes efficiently and accurately.

As a bus technician, you become part of a dynamic team specializing in the maintenance and repair of both traditional and electric buses. You combine mechanical knowledge with electrical and electronic expertise, and get the opportunity to deepen your skills even further. You'll work alongside colleagues who, like you, want to move forward in this evolving sector.

A typical day includes preparing new vehicles for delivery, performing maintenance and repairs, and diagnosing electric buses using software and measurement systems. You'll help with breakdowns, carry out interventions on location, and ensure all completed work is accurately registered in the system. Regular meetings with the workshop supervisor and teammates ensure a smooth workflow and the necessary support.

Are you ready to take your technical skills to the next level and become part of a fast-evolving sector? Apply today and make a difference in a growing team!

• You have at least a lower or higher secondary education diploma, preferably in a technical field

• At least 2 years of relevant work experience in a technical position with buses, trucks, vans, or electricity

• Strong knowledge of mechanics and electricity; experience with diagnostics and electronic vehicles is a plus

• You can work independently, take initiative, and have a hands-on attitude

• You are eager to learn and want to grow in the electric vehicle sector

• You have a category B driver’s license

• You have good verbal and written skills in Dutch or English

• Plus: HEV technician certificate (E2/E3) or willingness to obtain, and category D driver’s license

• You are flexible, reliable, and result-oriented

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 

airline and MICE guests. 

Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 

it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll do
You'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 

• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 

• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 

• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 

• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 

• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 

• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 

• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are
• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 

• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 

• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 

• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 

• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 

• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Ready to take ownership of accounting operations and drive continuous improvement in a dynamic IT Services & Consulting environment in Leuven? Join as a GL Accountant and make a direct impact on financial performance and transformation projects. 

Your responsibilities as GL Accountant : 

• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities for Belgian and Luxembourg operations.
• Ensure accurate reporting under Local GAAP and IFRS standards.
• Manage accruals, provisions, depreciations, deferrals, and other closing entries.
• Analyze financial fluctuations and explain variances versus previous periods.
• Coordinate and support the offshore Accounts Payable and accounting support teams.
• Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations and accounting documentation.
• Support internal and external audits and contribute to the preparation of annual accounts.
• Oversee VAT declarations and corporate tax accrual processes with external partners.
• Deliver ad hoc financial analyses and reports for management.
• Drive process improvements, reporting enhancements, and accounting best practices.
• Support accounting alignment and system optimization initiatives during business transformation.

About You : 

• You hold an Accounting degree and have at least 5 years of experience as a GL Accountant.
• You are comfortable acting as a trusted finance partner for colleagues and stakeholders.
• You take ownership, embrace change, and contribute to operational excellence initiatives.
• You have a solid understanding of payroll-related cost structures.
• You communicate effectively and build strong relationships across teams.
• You have experience with IFRS and corporate income tax.
• You have knowledge of SAP/S4HANA, which is considered an advantage.
• You are accurate, resilient under pressure, and highly organized.
• You are a collaborative team player with a proactive mindset.
• You speak Dutch and English fluently; French is a plus.
• You enjoy working in a social, energetic, and positive environment.

Your role

As a Night Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved in breakdown assistance. You will ensure that requests are handled efficiently and that every case is followed up accurately.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and requests simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

 
• 
Taking the appropriate action in urgent or unexpected situations.

Working hours

This is a night position with a specific and attractive work schedule.

You will work:

 
• 
3 nights per week

 
• 
From 20:00 until 08:00

 
• 
The rest of the week is free

This schedule offers a great work-life balance, with several days off during the week.

Night shifts are compensated with additional night premiums.

Flexibility regarding the three scheduled night shifts is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask, while remaining calm and professional during the night.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential and the main working language.

 
• 
Good knowledge of French.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in customer service, administration or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Comfortable working independently during night shifts.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new situations and procedures.

 
• 
Reliable, responsible and eager to learn.

Our customer is an international company active in the healthcare industry (medical devices) having its European headquarters based in Zaventem.

Jobomschrijving

As Payroll & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for the full, accurate and timely management of the company's payroll administration for all employees, in full compliance with legal requirements and internal policies.
You play a central role in optimising payroll processes, with a strong affinity for Compensation & Benefits, and actively contribute to broader HR projects.

Key responsibilities:- Ensure the accurate execution of the monthly payroll cycle, including salary calculations, benefits, taxes and social security contributions.
- Deliver ad-hoc reporting and analytics, providing detailed insights into payroll costs, HR trends and other key performance indicators.
- Work closely with the external payroll provider (e.g. SD Worx) to guarantee a smooth and reliable payroll operation.
- Manage and continuously improve processes related to leave, absences and employee benefits (insurance plans, meal vouchers, etc.).
- Act as the primary point of contact for employees regarding payroll and benefits-related queries, with the ability to clearly explain payroll related processes.
- Actively contribute to HR projects, including initiatives aimed at improving payroll and compensation efficiency and the implementation of new HR tools or solutions.
- Ensure full compliance with social and tax legislation and promote best practices within the payroll function.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in a relevant field or equivalent by experience

- You can demonstrate more than 4 years of experience in payroll management. Any additional experience with the UK, Germany, or the Netherlands payroll systems is considered an asset.

- You have a very good knowledge of the Belgian social legislation

- You are fluent in English and Dutch (both written and spoken), knowledge of French is an asset.

- You possess good communication skills allowing you to clearly explain HR payroll related processes to varied stakeholders

- You are customer oriented, can handle confidential information with the necessary discretion and enjoy working within an international and multicultural environment

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.
